question: Estimate the social media reach of a viral hashtag movement during a brand crisis or controversy.
idealClarificationQuestions: Negative virality (e.g., a brand misstep going trend)? Yes.
All platforms: X + Instagram + LinkedIn + WhatsApp + news? Multi-platform.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Trending hashtag dynamics: organic mentions × follower reach × media amplification.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Hashtag mentions over 5 days (typical brand crisis virality): ~5-10 lakh tweets/posts.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Organic reach across all mentions: ~10-15 crore impressions.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus WhatsApp/Telegram forwards (impossible to track precisely): ~5-10 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: But many people see fragments only; deeply engaged audience: ~5-10 crore.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Hashtag mentions over 5 days (typical brand crisis virality)
Reach of each post (avg follower count of users posting)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~500-1,000 followers each, but top influencers add 1-5M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus WhatsApp/Telegram forwards (impossible to track precisely)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~30-50 crore Indians exposed to the controversy in some form.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: But many people see fragments only; deeply engaged audience

calculationFlow: Hashtag mentions over 5 days (typical brand crisis virality): ~5-10 lakh tweets/posts.
Organic reach across all mentions: ~10-15 crore impressions.
Plus news coverage (mainstream + digital news): ~30-50 crore additional reach.
Plus WhatsApp/Telegram forwards (impossible to track precisely): ~5-10 crore.
Total unique reach: ~30-50 crore Indians exposed to the controversy in some form.
But many people see fragments only; deeply engaged audience: ~5-10 crore.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: But many people see fragments only; deeply engaged audience: ~5-10 crore.
